selection: Equal random fresh units per layer, excluding all previously screened library units; both signs, shuffled once before generation. Time cutoff may leave incomplete units.
normalization: Signed unit effective MLP write column, including learned MLP gain, multiplied by prompt residual median norm and dose; added after the block at all positions.
judging: Codex editorial review of deduplicated discovery replies and selected pair replies; mechanical triage is not a quality or identity judge. Unreviewed outputs retain no invented ratings.
goal: Surprising, readable new personas; literal preservation of both parent identities is not required.
limitations: Time-limited exploratory sample, not an exhaustive atlas
Wide screen uses one fixed 1.0× dose and 48-token cap; finalists use 160 tokens
Selection is editorial, not blinded or a population estimate
One prompt, greedy decoding, quantized model; batch layout can affect replies

resumes.reason: Measured throughput optimization; preserve all prior attempts and skip previously generated conditions.

coverage_note: Only generated conditions are counted. Additional enrichment plans and all amendments are preserved separately; planned but unexecuted neurons are excluded.
rounds: Full solo reruns and editorial selection
sampling: Time-limited fresh stratified random sample, plus two fixed stronger-dose random enrichments in layers 20–39; all old library units excluded. See enrichment_plan.json, supplemental_plan.json and protocol_amendments.json. Not a population-rate estimate.
